formal_statement: let x1 : Fin (13 : ℕ) → Fin (13 : ℕ) → Prop := fun (x1 x2 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => x1 = x2 ∨ x1 = x2 + (1 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) ∨ x1 = x2 + (3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) ∨ x1 = x2 + (9 : Fin (13 : ℕ)); ∀ (x2 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x2 → x2.size ≤ (63 : ℕ) → (∀ (x5 x6 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), x1 x5 x6 → (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (26 : ℕ) x2 fun (x8 : Fin (26 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x8 = Fin.castAdd (13 : ℕ) x5 ∨ x8 = Fin.natAdd (13 : ℕ) x6)) = Bool.true) → ∃ (x6 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))) (x7 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))), (∀ x8 ∈ x6, ∀ x10 ∈ x7, ¬x1 x8 x10) ∧ (∀ (x8 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), {x9 ∈ x6 | x1 x9 x8}.card ≤ (2 : ℕ)) ∧ (∀ (x8 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), {x9 ∈ x7 | x1 x8 x9}.card ≤ (2 : ℕ)) ∧ ∀ (x8 : Fin (26 : ℕ) → Bool), (∀ x9 ∈ x6, x8 (Fin.castAdd (13 : ℕ) x9) = Bool.true) → (∀ x10 ∈ x7, x8 (Fin.natAdd (13 : ℕ) x10) = Bool.true) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (26 : ℕ) x2 x8 = Bool.true
plain_statement: Plane of order 3. Every circuit of AND and OR gates, at most two inputs a gate, with at most 63 gates that is true at every incident point-line pair is true at every input containing some point set X and line set Y with no point of X on a line of Y, no three points of X on a line and no three lines of Y through a point.
title: A step toward: Order-3 plane: every fan-in-two AND/OR circuit true at incident pairs and false at all generic maximal false inputs has at least 64 gates
